{{short description|German mathematician and materials scientist}}
'''Barbara Niethammer''' (born 1967) is a German mathematician and [[materials science|materials scientist]] who works as a professor at the [[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]] at the [[University of Bonn]].<ref name="profile">[http://www.hcm.uni-bonn.de/people/profile/barbara-niethammer/ Faculty profile], [[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]], retrieved 2016-06-30.</ref> Her research concerns [[partial differential equation]]s for physical materials, and in particular the phenomenon of [[Ostwald ripening]] by which particles in liquids grow over time.

==Education and career==
Niethammer completed her PhD in 1996 at the [[University of Bonn]], under the supervision of [[Hans Wilhelm Alt]]. Her dissertation was ''Approximation of Coarsening Madels by Homogenization of a Stefan Problem''.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=29029}}</ref>

After postdoctoral research at the [[Courant Institute]], she returned to Bonn for her [[habilitation]] in 2002, after which she became in 2003 a professor at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]]. She moved to the [[University of Oxford]] in 2007, where she was a fellow of [[St Edmund Hall, Oxford|St Edmund Hall]]. In 2012 she returned as a professor to the University of Bonn.<ref name="profile"/>

==Recognition==
Niethammer won the [[Richard von Mises Prize]] of the [[Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik]] in 2003 for her work on Ostwald ripening,<ref>[https://www.gamm-ev.de/index.php/en/foundation-prize/mises-prize-laure.html Richard von Mises Laureates] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190624103438/https://www.gamm-ev.de/index.php/en/foundation-prize/mises-prize-laure.html |date=2019-06-24 }}, [[Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik|GAMM]], retrieved 2016-06-30.</ref> and the [[Whitehead Prize]] of the [[London Mathematical Society]] in 2011 "for her deep and rigorous contributions to material science, especially on the Lifshitz–Slyozov–Wagner and Becker–Doering equations".<ref>[https://www.lms.ac.uk/prizes/list-lms-prize-winners List of LMS prize winners], retrieved 2016-06-30.</ref><ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/201109/rtx110901299p.pdf|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|department=Mathematics People|title=Prizes of the London Mathematical Society|page=1301|date=October 2011|volume=58|issue=9}}.</ref>

She was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2014.<ref>[http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |date=2017-11-24 }}, retrieved 2016-06-30.</ref>
